answer: The network caps how much any single account can take per epoch, so even a cleverly large farm cannot monopolize one epoch's rewards — the surplus is spread across many passing identities. So the design does not rely on catching every cheat — it makes cheating unprofitable, which is a far more stable defense than any whitelist ever could be.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a relic as the anchor of the cost.
